summary: Post-Merge Title Refinement feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (100%). Frontend: Refine Title button, loading state, and 'refined' badge all verified working. Live LLM call successfully refined 'Women's bikini' to 'Orange and Black Floral Contrast Trim Bikini Set' — matching the exact use case from the problem statement.

minor.issue: Post-merge title refinement intermittently returns empty title due to LLM JSON parse error: 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)'. The merge itself still succeeds (refinement is wrapped in try/except), and response correctly returns title_refined=false + refined_title=''. Standalone refine-title endpoint worked reliably (single-image and multi-image cases). The brittle JSON parsing in services/field_listing.py:373-377 only handles markdown fences — empty/non-JSON LLM responses cause a fallback to no-refinement. Suggest hardening: regex-extract first JSON object, or retry once on parse failure.

integration_issues.flow: Refine Title in expanded detail editor
integration_issues.issue: After refine-title succeeds, the row title and 'refined' badge update immediately, but the inline TITLE <input> in the expanded detail editor still shows the old draft_title until the user collapses+expands or refreshes. The local edit state in FieldListingBatch.js does not sync with the refreshed item.draft_title.

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/field-listing/items/{nonexistent}/refine-title returns 404 with 'Item not found'
Backend: POST /api/field-listing/items/{item_id}/refine-title with images returns refined_title, persists title_refined=true and updated draft_title in DB
Backend: POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/merge-items response now includes title_refined (bool) and refined_title (str) fields
Backend: Merge with 2 photos still succeeds even when LLM refinement fails (graceful degradation)
Frontend: 'Refine Title' button (data-testid='refine-title-{item_id}') visible only on multi-image items (2+ images) in expanded detail view
Frontend: Clicking Refine Title shows 'Refining...' loading state on the button
Frontend: After refinement, item title in row updates (e.g., 'Women\'s bikini' → 'Orange and Black Floral Contrast Trim Bikini Set')
Frontend: 'REFINED' amber badge appears next to refined titles in the item row
Frontend: 'Merging & Refining Title...' loading text exists in code (line 464 of FieldListingBatch.js) — verified by code review
action_items: Sync local edit state for inline TITLE input in expanded detail editor with refreshed item.draft_title after refine-title succeeds (FieldListingBatch.js handleRefineTitle)
Harden refine_merged_title() JSON parsing in services/field_listing.py to better handle empty/non-JSON LLM responses (regex-extract first JSON object or single retry)
critical_code_review_comments: services/field_listing.py:373-377 — markdown fence stripping is fragile (assumes \n separator); LLM responses without newlines or with prefix text will cause json.loads to fail. Consider regex `re.search(r'\{.*\}', text, re.DOTALL)` then json.loads on the match.

routes/field_listing.py:843-876 — refine_item_title returns 500 when refinement fails. This is fine but consider returning a more specific status (e.g., 502 Bad Gateway for upstream LLM failures) to differentiate from server bugs.
FieldListingBatch.js:172-181 — handleRefineTitle uses alert() for both success and failure; consider toast notifications for consistency with other actions.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_title_refinement.py (new file — 8 tests covering refine-title endpoint + merge response contract + regression smoke)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_TitleRefinement_Batch (cleaned up). Refined one existing item in 'Test Batch' (id=54a19ecb-...) — title changed from 'Women\'s bikini' to 'Orange and Black Floral Contrast Trim Bikini Set'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Title refinement feature works. New endpoint POST /api/field-listing/items/{item_id}/refine-title returns 404/400/200/500 correctly. Merge endpoint now returns title_refined (bool) + refined_title (str) — even when LLM fails, merge still succeeds with title_refined=false. Frontend has data-testid='refine-title-{item_id}' button on multi-image items in expanded view, shows 'Refining...' loading state, and 'REFINED' amber badge next to refined titles. Known issue: inline TITLE <input> in expanded editor doesn't update local state after refine — only row display updates. Known LLM brittleness: ~50% of merge refinements fail with JSON parse error (fallback works correctly). Live LLM via gpt-4o is wired and functional via Emergent LLM key.
